result.instructions: Tools for Wise, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our students have no class booked this month?"; "List the teachers of our institute who have the tag 'math'."; "Show me the parents linked to student 64b7f0c2e4a1b2c3d4e5f602.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Wise data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wisetutoring_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wisetutoring_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wisetutoring_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wisetutoring_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wisetutoring_get_user
tools.title: Get the connected user
tools.description: Get the Wise account behind this API key: name, email, profile (teacher, student or parent), namespace and plan status. Wise API: GET /user/getUser.

tools.name: wisetutoring_get_institute
tools.title: Get the institute
tools.description: Get the connected institute: name, institute code, owner, type and settings. Wise API: GET /institutes/{instituteId}.

tools.name: wisetutoring_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the teaching locations of the institute. Wise API: GET /institutes/{instituteId}/locations.

tools.name: wisetutoring_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags of the institute, optionally for one type (for example student or teacher). Wise API: GET /institutes/{instituteId}/tags.

type.description: Tag type to filter by, as Wise defines it.

tools.name: wisetutoring_list_teachers
tools.title: List teachers
tools.description: List the teachers of the institute, one page at a time, with optional search, tags and class counts. Wise API: GET /institutes/v2/{instituteId}/teachers.

searchTerm.description: Search by teacher name or contact.

teacherTags.description: Comma-separated tags. Teachers with all of them are returned.

tools.name: wisetutoring_list_students
tools.title: List students
tools.description: List the students of the institute, one page at a time, with optional search, class, status and tag filters. Wise API: GET /institutes/v3/{instituteId}/students.

searchTerm.description: Search by student name or contact.

classIds.description: Comma-separated class ids. Only students in these classes.

status.description: Student status filter, as Wise defines it.

studentTags.description: Comma-separated tags. Students with all of them.

tools.name: wisetutoring_get_participant
tools.title: Get a participant
tools.description: Get one participant (student or teacher) of the institute by id: profile, status, tags and family code. Wise API: GET /institutes/{instituteId}/participants/{participantId}.

participantId.description: The id from another tool's result.

tools.name: wisetutoring_list_parents
tools.title: List parents
tools.description: List the parents of the institute, newest first, one page at a time. Not available in the wise and wise_lens namespaces. Wise API: GET /institutes/{instituteId}/parents.

searchTerm.description: Search by parent name or contact.

tools.name: wisetutoring_get_parent
tools.title: Get a parent
tools.description: Get one parent of the institute by id, with tags and the students linked to them. Not available in the wise and wise_lens namespaces. Wise API: GET /institutes/{instituteId}/parents/{parentId}.

parentId.description: The id from another tool's result.

tools.name: wisetutoring_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the reports generated for the institute, one page at a time. Wise API: GET /institutes/{instituteId}/reports.

selfOnly.description: Only reports the connected account created.

tools.name: wisetutoring_get_report
tools.title: Get a report
tools.description: Get the status of one generated report and, when it is ready, its download link. Wise API: GET /institutes/{instituteId}/reports/{reportId}.

reportId.description: The id from another tool's result.
